annotations.title: Wind & gust forecast with drone go/no-go (US, NWS)

description: Wind & gust forecast with drone go/no-go (US, NWS) — Hour-by-hour wind speed, gusts and direction for the next 6-156 hours (hours=, default 48) from the National Weather Service gridpoint forecast, in mph and knots, local times. Adds a peak summary, NWS wind advisory / high wind criteria check, daily maxima, wind categories and a small-drone FLY / CAUTION / NO-FLY rating with the calm flying windows. US locations by lat/lon or place. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).

place.description: or a place name, e.g. Chicago
